notes.title: Now Released!
notes.content:
Hot Rod Racer is now available for release! This arcade racer score based game was originally released on the Nintendo Wii U eShop in 2016. This new version includes new game modes, a new VS mode as well as new Vehicles and Upgrades to checkout out and unlock!

Gameplay

 Choose a Game Mode, Vehicle, Upgrade and Start Your Engine!
 Fire Rockets and Lasers to knock down obstacles and other vehicles in your way.
 Unlock new vehicles and upgrades to upgrade your play style.
 See if you can reach top spot on the Leaderboards!


Versus Mode

 Pick a Buddy and Race them!
 Use 2 Controllers or play with a single Keyboard.
 All the same Modes, Vehicles & Upgrades as the Single Player experience.
 Will you be victorious?


Features:

 Multiple Game Modes
 2 Player Versus Modes (with single keyboard support)
 Multiple Vehicles To Unlock
 Various Upgrades To Unlock
 Extra Wacky Visual Modes
 Endless Replayability
 Achievements
 Leaderboards

notes.title: Post Next Fest Demo Updated
notes.content:
New Demo update is now available, this includes the following changes:


FPS fix for higher frame rate devices.
Red Barrel graphic changed to help show it's a danger compared to the other helpful blue/red barrels.
Helpful Tip additions.


Thank you everyone who checked out the game during Steam Next Fest. Your feedback and been wonderful! Hot Rod Racer fully launches on November 19th, 2024. See you soon!

If you have any suggestions, bugs or issues - feel free to reach out via the Steam Forums or on Discord.

notes.title: Ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The Demo for Steam Next Fest is fully ready to be played and enjoyed! Fully updated and ready to launch, the demo will show off the game, its single player and two player versus mode as well as the 1st 15 upgrades to be earned as a tease.

This game is a remake of the Nintendo Wii U eShop version, with improvements all around, including new vehicles, game modes, upgrades, a two player versus mode and more!

Hot Rod Racer will fully launch on November 18th, 2024 for $1.99 USD. There will be a 40% discount for the game at launch.
